NAME: DX7
DESCRIPTION: Yamaha DX7 FM synthesis (port of the Schwung 'Dexed' module for Ableton Move, using Google's MSFA engine). Headless: control it from a Force MIDI track via CC (Q-Link) or from the web panel. Requires the separate ForceAudioIn addon to be enabled (arms the shared injection tap at boot, zero voices) - this toggle only starts/stops the dx7_host process itself, no LD_PRELOAD/acvs involved. Autoload is deliberately unavailable here: a voice must never be attached before an acvs restart - always start it after boot, from this page. Works out of the box with a built-in Init patch; drop your own DX7-compatible .syx bank files into this addon's banks/ folder for real patches. See README.md / docs/CC-MAP.md.
